summary.short: Bill PLP 112/2021 (Brazil, presented 3 August 2021, pending) would enact a new Electoral Code setting norms for parties, party finances, voter registration, candidate eligibility, electoral courts and elections. It is not AI-specific; it includes rules on paid online content boosting and data protection.
summary.long: PLP 112/2021 (text provided as part 1 of 5, Arts. 1–191) would institute a new Electoral Code. Livro I sets electoral principles and application rules. Livro II covers voting rights and duties: voting is compulsory from 18, optional at 16–17 and over 70, with fines for non-voting. Livro III governs political parties: TSE registration, internal autonomy, party finances (Fundo Partidário, donation bans, spending rules including paid online content boosting), and audits with fines for irregular accounts. Livro IV organises the Electoral Justice, electoral prosecutors and electoral defenders. Livro V sets voter registration, transfer and cancellation. Livro VI covers election dates, electoral systems and ineligibility grounds, including conduct by internet agents. Livro VII sets candidate eligibility and resignation requirements. Party processing of member data must follow the LGPD. Obligations address parties, candidates, electoral authorities and voters; the text is not AI-specific.
